name: Scalp Head Hair Massager Electric Health Care Antistress Relax Body Massagem Deep Saude Tissue Prevent Body Massage Mini Scalp
description:
Full Head & Body Massage – Effectively relieves fatigue, soothes the body, and helps with headaches, insomnia, and stress.

Red Light Therapy – Equipped with 3 built-in red light beads that penetrate the scalp, stimulate vitality, and promote healthy scalp maintenance.

Adjustable Massage Strength – Three intensity levels allow you to choose the most comfortable setting for deep relaxation.

96 Silicone Massage Contacts – Removable massage heads with multiple contact points provide an all-round acupoint massage.

Multi-Purpose Use – Suitable for head, neck, shoulders, arms, waist, abdomen, calves, and feet.

Compact & Portable – Lightweight design makes it easy to carry anywhere for on-the-go relaxation.

Specifications:

Rated Voltage: 5V

Rated Power: 5W

Static Current: 20uA MAX

Battery Capacity: 600mAh (Rechargeable Lithium Battery)

Usage Time: Approx. 30 minutes

Product Dimensions: 95 × 95 × 70 mm

Packing Size: 12.3 × 12.3 × 10 cm

Package Includes:

1 × Head Massager

1 × USB Charging Cable

1 × User Manual (Chinese & English)
